ns2:section.sectionText: Students should only register for one section of FSHN 120. For this in-person section, students will meet in a classroom each Wednesday from 11:00-11:50. In addition to the in-person meeting, there will be a recorded lecture that students are expected to watch outside of the classroom time. ***You will receive a welcome email from the instructor with further instruction prior to the start of the semester. For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/nutrition-fshn120/online-vs-in-house/ If you have any questions about the course, feel free to e-mail the lead instructor (Toni Gist) at burkhalt@Illinois.edu
